fact: Sierraloaded reports WanGov, deployed at the Gbalamuya border post by the Road Safety Authority and Korlie Ltd, lets people pay online for government services including business registration, permits and licences, with documents collected at the border; no count of services is given.
Minister Salamatu Bah said the ministry created the "One Government Platform", a centralized one-stop portal allowing citizens to access all government services and information.

The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation launched the WanGov app, where users apply for services, submit documents, track applications and pay, with business registration, tax filings and permits, driver's licences and EDSA meter installations named and more to be added.
The Sierra Leone Police announced on 30 July 2026 that all Police Clearance Certificate applications are now processed entirely through the WanGov platform at www.wan.gov.sl.

SierraLoaded reports that the National Investment Board demonstrated its newly developed Online Business Registration System to the communication minister, letting applicants reserve a name, upload ID and download certificates online, with the NIN integration with NCRA still being worked on.

A Government of Sierra Leone presentation lists a unified website and central government service portal, and MDA-specific online services, among its e-government successes and ongoing efforts, with no count of services.

Sierra Leone's President launched the National Investment Board's Online Business Registration System on 10 November 2026, which the document says brings 66 NIB services online (seven registration, 53 post-registration, five document and an appeals service) for applying, uploading documents, tracking and obtaining certificates.

Sierra Leone Monitor reports President Bio launched the National Investment Board's Online Business Registration System on 10 November 2026, with complete applications to be processed within 24 hours.
